subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

There was no luggage standing by to indicate an __**imminent**__ departure.
solution:
The correct answer is '**impending**'.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ​​​The word ‘**imminent**’(adjective) means- "coming or likely to happen very soon". (बहुत जल्द आने या होने की संभावना)

 
 
• E.g: *Her remarks were intended to scotch rumours of an **imminent **election date.*
